rationale: Record that an input-routing and web-compat fix crosses the render-assets-and-backends selector (core/view/**) without touching anything the family is about. core/view/src/overlay_dismissal.cpp and core/view/src/view.cpp let an outside press close every level of a nested overlay stack (a claim records the entry it nested on; core/view/include/pulp/view/view.hpp gains the accessor), and core/view/js/web-compat-document.js makes window.innerWidth/innerHeight read the live root size instead of the constants 800/600. No renderer, backend, Skia/Dawn path, asset, painter, canvas or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
